acceptanceCriteria: Fresh init and adopt produce a useful cited receipt at p95 under five minutes and fall back before ten without build, network, account or model.
Cold and incremental index results are byte-identical for the qualified corpus.
Corruption, staleness, dirty state, unsupported input and rollback produce deterministic bounded outcomes.
body: Qualify the two activation doors and native immutable index lifecycle on supported Darwin and Linux targets.
title: Qualify init, adopt and deterministic index lifecycle
